events.verdict: Melton (GSW) initiates illegal contact with Sengun's (HOU) arm during his shot attempt.
Santos (GSW) legally contests Sengun's (HOU) post shot attempt.
Melton (GSW) briefly clasps Thompson's (HOU) arm and marginal contact occurs as he defends the drive. Thompson loses the ball on his own following after the expiration of the marginal contact.
Horford (GSW) avoids making contact with Sengun's (HOU) arm as he defends Sengun's (HOU) post shot attempt.
Podziemski (GSW) releases the throw-in before 5 seconds elapses.
Replay review of the foul called on Durant (HOU) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Durant makes contact to the ball prior to the inciental contact with Melton's (GSW) wrist.
Okogie (HOU) legally defends Horford (GSW) and does not initiate any illegal contact during the pass.
Sengun (HOU) establishes a screening position outside of Santos' (GSW) field of view and gives him a step to avoid the contact.
Horford (GSW) jumps alongside Thompson (HOU) and marginal body contact occurs during Thompson's play at the basket.
Smith Jr. (HOU) applies his hands to Santos' (GSW) upper body as he starts to drive, and the contact is marginal.
Green (GSW) initiates contact with Durant's (HOU) arm during his drive and the contact affects his SQBR.
Thompson (HOU) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Melton (GSW) prior to incidental arm contact occurring.
Green (GSW) initiates illegal contact with Thompson's (HOU) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Eason (HOU) and Horford (GSW) mutually engage and marginal contact occurs as Eason disengages to pursue the rebound.
Melton (GSW) initiates illegal contact with Durant's (HOU) body during his jump shot attempt.
Durant (HOU) re-reaches for the ball and avoids making contact with Melton's (GSW) arm as he defends his driving shot attempt.
Santos (GSW) makes contact with the ball after it exits the imaginary cylinder above the rim.
Sheppard (HOU) brushes Melton's (GSW) arm as he defends the shot attempt near the rim.
Green (GSW) commits a take foul on Durant (HOU).
Eason (HOU) commits a take foul on Santos (GSW).
